site.tagline: Evakuators.am — find a tow truck anywhere in Armenia
site.organizationDescription: Online platform for finding tow trucks in Armenia
site.description: Find tow trucks and crane trucks in every region of Armenia and in each district of Yerevan. See photos of the vehicles, the services and the prices — and call the driver directly.

home.heroTitle: — find a tow truck anywhere in Armenia
home.heroSubtitle: Pick your region or town, see the trucks available and call the driver straight away.
home.step1Text: Find your area with the search box or from the list.
home.step2Text: See photos of the vehicles, the prices and the services.
home.step3Text: Reach the driver by phone or WhatsApp — no middleman.
home.benefitCountryText: Tow trucks in every region and in all of Yerevan's districts.
home.benefitDirectText: Call the driver yourself — no middleman, no markup.
home.benefitPhotosText: See the actual truck before you call.
home.benefitHoursText: Day or night, there is always a truck working around the clock.
home.benefitSearchText: Search by region, town, service and load capacity.
home.benefitFreeText: Finding a truck and calling the driver is completely free.
